capability_statement: Operators can see whether provider-read evidence is current, stale, expired, or unknown before it is reused.
before_state: An accepted provider-read decision replay could be treated as current without a visible freshness gate.
after_state: Mission Control exposes freshness status and reuse decision from audited freshness records.
scenario: Before using provider-read evidence for a follow-on decision, the operator checks Mission Control to see whether the evidence can be used or must be refreshed.
five_minute_demo: Run visibility-export and inspect provider_read_freshness_refresh_projection.latest_freshness_status and latest_refresh_decision.
time_saved_or_work_reduced: Removes manual timestamp reconstruction before reusing provider-read evidence.
cognitive_load_removed: Operators no longer need to infer whether accepted provider evidence is also fresh enough to reuse.

capability_matrix.before: Freshness was implicit or manually inferred.
capability_matrix.after: Freshness status and reuse decision are explicit.
capability_matrix.user_value: Stale provider-read evidence cannot silently drive new work.

not_proven: Self-hosting product value evidence does not prove broad adoption or market value.
